subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Oral
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Oral"** means something that is spoken or related to the mouth. (मौखिक)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave an oral presentation in front of the class.
 
 
 
• **"Inscribed"** refers to something that is written or carved on a surface, usually to record or commemorate something. (उत्कीर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The names of the war heroes were inscribed on the monument.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'oral'** is **'inscribed'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Verbal **(शाब्दिक): Pertaining to or in the form of words.

 
 
• **Example:** They had a **verbal **agreement, but nothing was written down.
 
 
 
• **Obligatory** (अनिवार्य): Required by a legal, moral, or other rule.
 
 
• **Example:** Attending the weekly meeting is **obligatory** for all staff members.
 
 
 
• **Dejected** (उदास): Sad and depressed; dispirited.
 
 
• **Example:** After the loss, the entire team felt** dejected** and disappointed.
